name: nativekit-react-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Nativeblocks React SDKs (blockKit, actionKit) and sample app

scripts.build:kits: yarn workspace @nativeblocks/block-kit-react build && yarn workspace @nativeblocks/action-kit-react build
scripts.dev: yarn build:kits && yarn workspace sample start
scripts.dev:watch: yarn build:kits && yarn workspace sample start
